{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Drop refunded orders since they contribute negative revenue
# Only completed orders should be counted
completed_sales = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed']

# Group by channel and sum revenue
channel_revenue = completed_sales.groupby('channel', as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()

# Display the revenue per channel
print(channel_revenue)"}
